source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
What this rule allows depends on your [Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction):

- If it is **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM**, choose one of this publication's detachments in the usual way when you pick Detachment rules.
- If it is not, but all your army's models have **IMPERIUM**, you may still add **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM** units, up to a cap set by battle size.

The caps for Retinue, Character and Requisitioned units are:

- Incursion: 1 Retinue, 1 Character and 1 Requisitioned.
- Strike Force: 2 Retinue, 2 Character and 1 Requisitioned.
- Onslaught: 3 Retinue, 3 Character and 2 Requisitioned.

Such an army may take **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEDICATED TRANSPORT** units through the usual rules, but each needs at least one unit aboard when the battle begins. An empty one is barred from deployment and counts as destroyed in the first battle round.
